title: Barog and Dagshai: The Toy Train's Longest Tunnel and an Old Hill Cantonment near Solan
seo_title: Barog & Dagshai near Solan: Tunnel 33, Jail Museum & How to Reach
seo_desc: Barog (about 1,560 m) on the Kalka–Shimla toy train, with the line's longest tunnel, and nearby Dagshai cantonment with its old jail museum: what to see, toy train tips, weekend stays and how to reach from Chandigarh.
